overview.description: The Tortoise AI Infrastructure ETF (TCAI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in equity securities, with an energy-adjacent investment strategy, by investing in infrastructure companies poised to benefit from the growth of AI. The fund may include US and non-US firms of any market capitalization. TCAI was launched on Aug 5, 2025 and is issued by Tortoise.
